execution_frontier.name: Protected R2B remainder continuation with DP and flow frozen
execution_frontier.summary: The batch-64 module rollback diagnostic isolates model_g.dp drift as the minimum sufficient cause of the protected R2 robustness regression. Restoring only model_g.dp from the promoted R1 hybrid into the exact batch-64 abort state restores 125/125 on all five deterministic seed schedules while retaining the batch-64 non-DP adaptation and its improved median output level. A new R2B continuation is authorized from that exact DP-restored batch-64 state with both model_g.dp and model_g.flow frozen/hash-protected. Because optimizer/RNG state was not saved, R2B is explicitly an optimizer-reset state continuation, not a mathematically exact batch-65 optimizer resume.

promoted_r1_hybrid.strengthened_gate: 125/125 on each of five deterministic schedules; 625/625 total

module_rollback_diagnosis.conclusion: Every tested variant that restores DP is 625/625; every tested variant retaining the batch-64 DP has failures. DP-only restoration is therefore the minimum-change repair and preserves useful non-DP R2 adaptation.
